tasks_completed.description: AC-2: SubagentStop orphan finalization with TOCTOU-safe re-read under lock
tasks_completed.changes: Added `_is_orphan_slot(payload)`, `_emit_orphan_log`, `_try_finalize_under_lock`, `_run_under_lock`, `_finalize_one_orphan`, `_iter_cp_files`, `_finalize_orphans`, `_run_dispatch_with_orphan_backstop`. Wired into main() so orphan finalize runs after `_dispatch` returns 0 (clean). Changed `_handle_no_active_state` from `sys.exit(0)` to `return 0` AND made `_dispatch` propagate it explicitly, so the orphan backstop also runs on the no-active-slot path. Re-read+write happens under flock to avoid clobbering concurrent spec-check.py mark/check-in. Stderr line: `SUBAGENT STOP orphan-finalize: <cp_file> (was is_running=true, agent_id=<id>, pid=<pid|none>)`. Codex follow-ups #1 and #3 addressed.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Three independent latent holes composed: (1) tool-policy granted each role direct write to its own cp-state, (2) Stop hook keyed exclusively on agent_id equality, (3) agent_resolver fell back to the first inactive cp-state match.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: AC-1: deny direct cp-state writes for all subagents via policy + path-specific guard hook. AC-2: backstop Stop hook with orphan finalization (re-read under lock, post-clean-dispatch). AC-3: tri-state resolver — inactive non-authoritative, collision fail-closed, active wins.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Minimum diff would be a 1-line policy edit + a 1-line resolver edit + a 5-line Stop hook addition. The actual diff is larger because: (a) AC-1 requires touching 16 role entries in tool-policy.v1.json (15 roles + 1 _shared_protected_path_prefixes section); each role has 2 lines removed + 2 lines added + rationale string update — multiplied by 16 = ~96 of the 364 line touches. (b) AC-1b creates a 165-line new hook, which is the smallest implementable size given the requirements (path glob check + Bash extraction integration + orchestrator bypass + tri-state subagent detection + diagnostic message + fail-safe wrapper + quality-gate compliance for max function size of 30 lines and max nesting depth of 3). (c) AC-2 grew from a single _finalize_orphans() to 7 helpers because of (i) quality-gate max-30-line/max-depth-3 constraints forced extracting `_iter_cp_files`, `_emit_orphan_log`, `_try_finalize_under_lock`, `_run_under_lock`; (ii) codex-found TOCTOU bug forced lock-protected re-read+write; (iii) codex-found no-active-slot regression forced changing `_handle_no_active_state` from sys.exit to return-then-orphan-backstop. None of these are speculative — every line traces to either an AC requirement, a quality-gate hard constraint, or a codex-substantive finding.
